title: Run harvest pocket — per-session quicksheet
content:
Purpose: tiny daily ledger for short-run experiments (fast compare of batch/cache/quant trades).

FORMAT: CSV-style table for quick paste into Sheets when needed. Rows are chronological (newest bottom).

date,session_id,model,quant,seq_len,batch_size,requests,tokens_per_request,median_ms,p95_ms,cache_hit_rate,ops_cost_est_usd,notes
2024-08-14,run-0814-a,redwood-7b-q4,4-bit,512,8,120,450,42,98,0.18,0.42,baseline run — noisy start (cold cache)
2024-08-15,run-0815-b,redwood-7b-q4,4-bit,512,16,180,430,53,120,0.23,0.51,increased batch -> p95 up but median OK
2024-08-20,run-0820-c,redwood-7b-q8,8-bit,1024,4,90,980,61,150,0.45,0.78,8-bit quant looks promising on long seqs
2024-09-05,run-0905-d,redwood-7b-q4,4-bit,256,32,300,210,29,72,0.12,0.33,aggressive batching -> latency win median but p95 spikes
2024-09-18,run-0918-e,redwood-7b-q4,4-bit,512,8,200,460,40,88,0.60,0.38,prefix cache enabled (naive TTL 60s) -> big hit rate improvement
2024-09-27,run-0927-f,redwood-7b-q4,4-bit,512,8,220,455,39,82,0.66,0.36,cache tuned: exclude long-tail prefixes (filter by key hash)
2024-10-02,run-1002-g,redwood-7b-q4,4-bit,512,12,250,450,35,78,0.61,0.40,balanced batch 12 looks sweet for median/throughput

QUICK CALCS (back-of-envelope):
- tokens per second (approx): tps ~ (tokens_per_request * requests) / (median_ms/1000) -> example run-1002-g: (450*250)/(35/1000) ~ 3.21M tks/s across pool (note: per-GPU depends on pool size).
- cost est: ops_cost_est_usd is rough USD per 1k requests using current pricing table (local estimate).

NOTES / THINGS I SAW:
- Cache hit rate jump from 0.12 -> 0.66 after enabling prefix cache + TTL tweak. Reduce TTL for sessions with long-tail prefixes.
- p95 latency correlates strongly with batch size > 16 on this workload (sporadic queuing). Add circuit-breaker for queue depth.
- 8-bit quant improves long-sequence throughput but occasionally increases model output variance for edge prompts (flagged by Juniper).

OPEN QUESTIONS / TODOs (personal):
- [ ] rerun run-1002-g with KV cache warm for 10m and compare p95 (GH PR #789 reference).
- [ ] test batch 12 vs batch 8 with autoscaler bump to see tail behavior under load (ticket INF-234).
- [ ] capture s3 of raw requests for 3 runs to run offline eval for quality drift (shortlist prompts).

SNIPPET: quick decision rubric for choosing run config for small internal canary
- latency peak sensitive -> prefer batch <=8, cache aggressive, 4-bit
- throughput/cost sensitive -> batch 12-16, 4-bit or 8-bit if seq_len > 800
- quality-sensitive prompts -> prefer 8-bit or full-precision for targeted subset, instrument evals

NOTES TO SELF: keep this file small. Move mature experiments to shared_drives/engineering/applied-ml/experiment-archive when one shows stable perf.
summary: Personal compact ledger for quick experiment comparisons: batch/quant/cache vs latency and cost. Table + quick calcs + action TODOs.
